title: LG App Update Blocker
shortDescription: LG app update blocker with directly actionable Home icon fixes and visible error messages.
description: LG App Update Blocker with original Home icon launch-policy override, one-press changes without fragile browser dialogs, persistent success/failure reporting, opt-in no-update launches, cache inspection, and reboot-persistent update-domain blocking.

added: Five-way TV remote navigation with visible focus and OK-button support.
System firmware update cache can be inspected and cleared from the TV UI without SSH.
Secondary app-update dependency state can be inspected and cleared separately from the standard forced-update list, without SSH.
Installed-app inventory with per-app version, manifest update-check flag and live update-cache inspection.
Opt-in direct app launch using checkUpdateOnLaunch:false, with persisted diagnostic result and no update installation.
Reversible original Home icon fix: save the previous Content Store appinfo launch setting, set checkUpdateOnLaunch:false, and restore on demand.
fixed: Update-domain blocking now persists reliably across TV reboots without depending on service startup timing.
No extra launcher or duplicate Home icon is needed for supported Content Store apps; one full reboot reloads the updated app metadata.
Fix original Home icon action silently returning when webOS suppresses browser confirm() dialogs; explicit button press now immediately sends a reversible change.
Keep app-specific Home icon success/failure responses visible after status refresh and show the actual application directory reported by webOS.
